case_name: Heat damage: High Tmax + Low SM + Declining NDVI
rationale: High heat + severe SM deficit + canopy collapse -> MODERATELY/SEVERELY DAMAGED

case_name: Buffered: High Tmax + Sufficient SM + Stable NDVI (irrigated)
rationale: High temp but irrigation buffering -> NOT/LESS DAMAGED

case_name: Non-heat decline: Normal Tmax + Low NDVI
rationale: Low NDVI without heat -> disease/pest/drought, NOT heat damage

case_name: Heat + healthy vegetation: possible irrigation buffering
rationale: Irrigation-buffered heat stress -> at most LESS DAMAGED
Cold year NDVI decline -> NOT heat damage
Heatwave exposure but vegetation maintained -> subclinical

case_name: Mild heatwave + significant NDVI decline (possibly other cause)
rationale: Mild heat but large NDVI decline -> mixed attribution
